excerpt: Journalism Curriculum We prepare our journalism students as news reporters, editors, producers and photojournalists. They learn professional skills and concepts required for successful careers across multimedia platforms. Students develop skills in writing and editing, news gathering and reporting, media ethics and law. They practice news judgment to employ when editing print, digital, audio and video stories or designing and structuring websites.
